I would **not change the storage date without registered written permission**. The pending request and Wednesday booking are not permission, and neither takes the box off the manifest.

But I also would **not release today’s manifest**, because that would make destruction of the only originals irreversible before the authorised collector can arrive. I would immediately alert the manager and warehouse, document the reason, and make clear that I am holding the release as an exceptional safeguard—not treating it as an approved extension. Under the stated process, that means the whole batch will not dispatch and the shift will be recorded as incomplete. I would accept and report that consequence rather than allow this box to be destroyed.

I would keep the box secured and unchanged, then seek the duty manager’s written decision tomorrow. I would change the date only if permission is registered first, and record any resulting warehouse work and charge. I would not hand the box to Claire before the booked collection and the required in-person checks.
